correctness.rationale: The symbolic proof reduces cyclic palindrome-pair symmetry to a reversal-invariant six-mer spectrum; the explicit sixteen-context local table rules out every unequal boundary splice. Uniqueness of the four-block phase forces reflection symmetry to descend to the source word. An induction on k then exhausts every Thue–Morse factor at lengths 3·4^k; explicit source squares and primitive cyclic decoding yield the matching lower bound and disjoint rotation classes. Both standalone checkers execute correctly.

The exact upper bound and exclusion of incomplete conjugacy classes use a new local six-gram asymmetry lemma and four-uniform cyclic descent. Later Lie-complexity results count complete conjugacy classes and do not entail this absence of extra palindrome pairs.
